title: Surreal Portal Gathering
description: A surreal night scene depicts a green alien holding a glowing lantern on a hill, a large red mouse with a bandana standing on a branch by water, a camouflaged soldier crouching beside a glowing green skull, and a black cat leaping through a magical purple portal showing another landscape. A giant cracked moon with a sleeping face looms in the starry sky above a gothic castle and dead tree.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a green alien holding a glowing lantern on a sandy hill, a large red mouse wearing a bandana perched on a branch by a stream, a soldier in camouflage crouching next to a glowing green skull with purple eyes, and a black cat leaping through a magical purple and yellow portal that reveals a waterfall and another moon. A massive cracked moon with a sleeping human-like face dominates the starry pink and purple sky above a dark gothic castle and a leafless tree with hanging lanterns.
